svg.title: Sizzle's 6 themes, each shown in light and dark

g.text: The original. Bright yolk yellow on clean porcelain.
Inky buttons, with yolk saved for what you've ticked off.
Tomato red with a bit of heat.
Deep basil green. Calm, fresh and kind to food photos.
Beetroot magenta, for a cookbook nobody else has.
Diner cobalt that makes warm food photos pop.
